coordinateSystem: EPSG:2326 Hong Kong 1980 Grid, metres; source height datum retained without reinterpretation
gltfAxes: X east, Y source height, Z south. Local origin = group.originHK80; no geometric rotation or scale change.
attribution: Map from Lands Department. Copyright Hong Kong SAR Government.
limitations: Official 3D infrastructure is geographically cropped around exact TD stop IDs; the source mesh does not semantically name individual shelters.
Stops are identified by exact TD stopId join and compared between GTFS and official TD GeoJSON, not inferred from model appearance.
Only INFRASTRUCTURE(TB) source geometry is shown. Missing buildings or ground surfaces are excluded categories, not evidence of physical absence.
Model capture date was not established. HTTP Last-Modified is not the survey date.
Track topology, gauge and access connections are not derived from these visual meshes. Do not use them as routable or accessibility-certified geometry.

Crops use an oriented envelope extending 55 m along and 16 m across each exact stop anchor. Perimeter triangles are clipped with interpolated original UVs; interior geometry is unchanged. Canopy completeness is not semantically certified by source metadata.

Texture atlases are cropped to used UV bounds and downsampled to at most 1024 px with JPEG quality 86 or lossless PNG alpha. Source transparency, tiled-UV repeat behavior and material factors retained. Normals are normalized with inverse-transpose transforms; invalid zero source normals use geometric face normals. Interior geometry is losslessly indexed, without collapse decimation; only outer context is clipped.

projectUse: Academic visualization; no claim of certified survey, current condition, safe access, or routable track topology.

processing.boundaryClipping: Exact convex clipping of perimeter triangles to oriented group envelope; interior vertex positions unchanged
processing.decimation: No collapse decimation, to preserve canopy columns and platform geometry. Spatial crop + lossless attribute welding + bounded UV atlas textures provide reduction.
processing.sourceNormals: Inverse-transpose transformed and normalized; zero source normals replaced only with geometric face normals
processing.alpha: Original alpha-mode and PNG transparency retained
processing.sourceDate: Dataset HTTP last-modified varies by tile; not a capture/survey date
